title: SafetyConnect
caption: A quick tour of the SafetyConnect app.
say: Here's a quick tour of the SafetyConnect app.

title: Home
caption: Your driving score, trips and rank at a glance.
say: Your home screen shows your driving score, trips and rank.

title: Passenger mode
caption: Not driving? Switch to passenger mode. Trips are still tracked but won't affect your driving score, and SOS and collision alerts keep working.
say: Not the one driving? Switch to passenger mode. Your trips are still tracked, but won't affect your driving score, and S O S and collision alerts keep working.

title: Working hours
caption: Set your working hours and business mode turns on automatically. Outside them you're in personal mode: those trips are visible only to you, not your organisation.
say: Set your working hours, and business mode turns on automatically. Outside them, you're in personal mode, and those trips are visible only to you, not your organisation.

title: Score breakdown
caption: Tap any score to see how it's calculated.
say: Tap any score to see how it's calculated.

title: What to improve
caption: See what to work on, plus quick safety tips.
say: The app shows you what to work on, plus quick safety tips.

title: Trips
caption: Every trip is recorded automatically, with its own score.
say: Every trip is recorded automatically, with its own score.

title: Trip details
caption: See the route, and where each unsafe event happened.
say: Open one to see the route, and where each unsafe event happened.

title: Reports
caption: Weekly and monthly reports track your progress.
say: Weekly and monthly reports track your progress.

title: SOS
caption: In an emergency, slide to alert your emergency contact, or call 112.
say: In an emergency, slide to alert your emergency contact, or call one one two.

title: Documents & languages
caption: Keep vehicle documents handy, and use the app in your own language.
say: Keep your vehicle documents handy, and use the app in your own language.
